clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Thork sends proven Horde fighters north to report to Kadrak. The orc holds a watch tower near the Ashenvale border and prepares recruits for the fighting ahead.

The Crossroads faces quilboar, centaur, and local brigands, while the Horde looks north to Ashenvale's thick forests. Thork directs fighters who have proved themselves in the central Barrens to the northern border tower, where Kadrak is stationed.

Kadrak oversees the southern approach to Ashenvale and organizes reinforcements for the Horde's foothold across the border. Splintertree Post and an outpost along the Zoram Strand help the Horde strengthen its presence in the timber-rich woodlands, where native night elves resist them fiercely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
